hypothesis: High volume change is associated with next-day BTC return
result: High-volume and normal-volume next-day returns were not significantly different

hypothesis: Price range is associated with next-day BTC return
result: Weak discovery evidence disappeared completely in OOS testing

hypothesis: Volume effect on next-day return changes by trend regime
result: No significant interaction in discovery or OOS testing

hypothesis: Higher price range is associated with higher future 7-day volatility, and this relationship may vary by market regime.
method: OLS + HAC(7) + Trend Regime Interaction + Volatility Regime Interaction + 70/30 Out-of-Sample Validation
result: Price range remained significantly positively associated with future 7-day volatility in both discovery and OOS. Trend-regime and volatility-regime interactions were not statistically significant.

hypothesis: Current 10-day volatility is positively associated with future 7-day volatility.
result: 10-day volatility was positively associated with future 7-day volatility in discovery and remained positive and statistically significant in OOS. Coefficient decreased from 0.4330 to 0.2919, while OOS R-squared was 0.070.

hypothesis: Price range and current 10-day volatility jointly explain future 7-day volatility.
method: Multiple OLS + HAC(7) + 70/30 Time-Based Out-of-Sample Validation
result: Both price range and 10-day volatility were positively associated with future 7-day volatility in discovery and remained statistically significant in OOS. OOS R-squared was 0.119.
